Name: Every Single Bundle
Author: evoglobin
Description:
[center]For this to work properly, you MUST make a [b]new save [/b]with [b]vanilla bundles[/b], otherwise it will break your existing save's bundles/duplicate bundles.

This mod adds every bundle in the game (normal + remixed)

New 1.6 bundles are: Spirit's Eve, Winter Star, Helper, Forest


[size=4][b]-Bundle Additions & Changes[/b]-[/size]

[i]Forest [/i]Bundle[i] [/i]is in the Crafts Room

[i]Spirit's Eve, Helper, & Winter Star[/i] Bundles are in the Bulletin Board

[i]Enchanter's & Field Research[/i] Bundles have been moved to the Boiler room to make room for the new Bulletin Board bundles.﻿ This is unavoidable as you can fit no more than 9 bundles on a screen.

[i]Home Cook's[/i] bundle requires dishes instead of 10 eggs, 10 milk, 100 wheat flour. (idk how to make it so any egg or any milk is needed)

Seasonal crop bundles now have the new 1.6 crops as options (Carrot, Summer Squash, Broccoli)[/center][center]﻿[/center][center]﻿[/center]
